[quote=botshukudu;61073064]So why Sealiphate? Other than a pun since it's normal spelt with a 'c' and not 'sea'[/quote]
[i]The title is derived once more from the founder of Itiammudism, Itiammud is considered the Seal of Muhammedian Sainthood. The title of Sealiph can only be inherited from the Iyaiids, the tribe from which Itiammud is descended. The Iyaiids are designated with the responsibility of safeguarding Itiammudism as the truest form of Islam. The Sealiph has the responsibility of not only the knowledge passed down through Itiammud's bloodline, but the interpretation of Sharia. As it was written by Itiammud, "Those who inherit my burden, not only inherit the divine knowledge passed down by the blood which flows through me, but the duty of interpretation and from that duty are both burdened and honoured by the Seal of Interpreation." From that honorific and special designation, the name Sealiphate is derived.[/i]
~Overview of Irocco

[b]July 22, 2027: To Make the Fleet Great Again[/b]

Rosenmarkke had 3 aircraft carriers, 18 destroyers, 33 frigates, and 28 submarines of which 12 were nuclear. However, compared to most of the other fleets in the world the meagre 82 vessels which the navy possessed were seen as inadequate by most within the SCSID and armed forces. Concerns revolving around projection, image, and of course aging vessels (as noted in the SCSID report of January). 

Thus it was approved by the PDC to allocate $25 billion of the $81.9 billion renewal fund towards the construction of ten new destroyers equipped with 2x 4.5 inch naval guns, 2 twin missile launchers for sea dart missile, 2x triple anti-sub torpedo tubes. The construction of the ten ships would be split between four government dockyards and two private in order to ensure rapid construction. The ships would have a set commissioning date of 2028-2029. In the meantime another $3 Billion would be allocated towards the enlargement of the aging merchant marine with 50 naval supply ships, 17 oil tankers, and 53 light cargo ships in order to expand fleet convoy capacity. 

Overall the allocation would eat up $28 billion of the 81.9 billion fund.

[spoiler=Deploying, negotiating and a old enemy.]
[b][u]The Expeditionary force.[/u][/b]
The Nordiheimian Expeditionary Force (NEF for short) had been by now been fully deployed on Sabratan soil through one of the more southern harbors controlled by the Democratic Coalition, and was now moving inland towards the battle line that the democrats had with the IS.
Spesificly they were going to deploy themself slightly south of the "bulge" in the frontline that was a potential place for the IS army to force a breaktrough that could eventualy splitt the DC mainland forces in two, someting that could not be allowed to start happening so early on in the civil war, this placement would also allow the NEF to be close enough to the Royalist lines to the south for them to have the ability to react to anyting big happening there aswell which was a nice bonus.

Major Olian, the officer in charge of the NEF, sat in the commanders hatch of his brand new Drake VI and looked towards the sky as one of the recon flights from the large carrier group flew through the air to do its job of scouting the sky for potential hostile treaths, allready hard to see with how high it allready was, as he thought about the one problem that was allready on his mind when it came to the military force that he had been given command off.
The force was on papper a mighty one despite only being made up of ten thousand men but for someone of his experience it had one large glearing problem, especially here in Sabrata, the big and hulking Drake V tank, it might have worked miracles back in Nordiheim during the Noble War with the nations great infrastructure and an opposing large tank to duke it out with, the big ting had proberly saved the war for them more then ones, but Sabrata did not have that infrastructure or a large tank to face that justificed its deployment, it fealt like the thing was here purely to show that it was stil relevant for the future.

Looking towards the rear of the collum Major Olian could see the beast that was the Drake V even though they were at the rear section, the large tanks had many aspects that was good or had been improved through the last 5 years of its life;
Wide tracks and filters to deal with sand that had been made after its problems in the eastern dessert areas of Nordiheim,
A powerfull gun that could punch through pretty much anyting that they could meet here in Sabrata,
Thick armor that could shrugh off equaly as many threaths,
And of corse the veteran crew that was driving them.
But despite all of this he would have rather had a bunch of old and reliable Drake IV tanks, or even the relativly untested Drake VI, because the Drake V had one disadvantage that he was allready expecting to become a problem rather quickly; Speed.
They were joust far to slow with its average top speed being half that of the older Drake IV, and with the railroad of Sabrata being unable to handle its weight and bulk it would be near impossible to replace any that would be lost any decent distance into the nation, he had infact allready sendt a "polite" message to high command before they even landed asking for it to be replaced with a different tank though it had been rejected which had not realy supriced him, though he didn't like it.

For now he would be a good little soldier and obey that old fool of a war minister but he had allready ordered the officers below him to collect any and all information and evidence of the Drake Vs not preforming well the moment it happened so that he could throw it back in the old mans face as quickly as he could to get rid of these hulking things, atleast metaphoricaly.
Thankfully he allready knew that Admiral Marli Aegireatt would support him in this endavor, she might be an admiral but she was able to recognice a bad idea when she saw it, she would make sure that any additional problems that appared on her end at the port and sea bound logistics route would have their weight added to his own reports.
Now to make sure that they chose the roads that would allow them to move at top speed, a task that would not be easy...

[b][u]Ports and a airfield for Hydronia[/u][/b]

The Hydronian president Halil Ozhid would be propperly recived by a carefully selected diplomatic team together with the Nordland minister that would conduct diplomatic talks with him, though they made sure that it took the required amount of time even though they allready knew exactly what ports and airfield they were going to allow the Hydronians to use, they did not want to seem rushed or miss any opportunity that might present itself to them such as when the Hydronian president presented them with the willingness to pay for the priviledge to use one of their airfield, money that would be well spent on future maintinence and upgrades to said airport.

President Halil were eventualy given the "good news" that Hydronia would be allowed to use the airfield Kiota in the northern part of the Nordland region, together with the large cargo port of Xhose that had a railway link all the way north to the airfield and the military port of Svearstoed as a convinient place for quick refuling and resupplying.
The question of naval cooperation was also given the green light after some negotiation, it benefited Nordiheim to after all, though some restrictions was put in place when it came to the density of naval fleets in Nordiheimian home waters the negotiations went relativly smoothly with both sides seeming pleased with the outcome.
The Nordiheimain diplomats did however make sure to give President Halil the impression that if things went nice and smoothly forward that more could be achived in the future between their two nations, perhaps even the potential for a national relationship that included the trade of goods when the time became right.

[b][u]On the subject of Royalties.[/u][/b]
Nordiheim was not blind to the fact that the DC had some desire to work together with the Royalists to be albe to focus their atention to the more hostile IS faction, and some people in Nordiheim could absolutely see the necesity of such a cooperation, but others found it more difficult as the hatered for royals and nobles ran deep in Nordiheim society.
As such the one in charge of Nordiheims efforts in Sabrata, Admiral Marli Aegireatt, gave the DC the message that they had her support in making diplomatic contact with the Royalists but that they should be carefull with how loudly they broadcasted it internationally, as many of her fellow countrymen would find it difficult to view it as pragmaticly as she were able to.

In the shadows of Nordiheim someting ells started to stir, a old and bitter enemy of the people of Nordiheim was realising that a opportunety was presenting itself for some much desired revenge, the Noble faction that had been defeated in the Noble war joust a few years ago had been beaten and bloodied in that war but they were not compleatly gone.
The few nobles that had survived and escaped the wrath of the Nordiheimian people still had some cards left to play.
They would send out two teams, one to the Islamic Socialists and one to the Kingdom of Dhornaper, the one to the IS would be the largest one for they would open contact with them and offer them many things that could benefit them in their civil war that would eventualy clash with Nordiheimian forces such as weapons, blueprints and people that could aid them in bolstering and advancing their industrial back bone.
The team to the Kingdom of Dhornaper would be smaller but more elite, their task was to negotiate with Ayub Khan for two tings;
To create a route trough Dhornaper to supply the IS with weapons and supplies from their still remaining hiden bases in Argos.
And to offer to pay for additional materials, be it for war or industry, to be supplied to the IS and their war effort for they still had a decent amount of resources in their vaults that they had no qualms about using to hurt Nordiheim.

And if either Dhornaper or the IS questioned them, a group of western style noble, about why they would support them in this they would simply tell them the truth, any defeat that could be given Nordiheim was a music to their souls that they would pay handsomly for.
Besides, why would they be ageinst outsiders providing the means to defeat outsiders? They would get the satisfaction of seeing outsiders hurting each other while they stayed strong, a double vitory realy.
[/spoiler]
